events.label: Искусство
entries: 1334 – The bishop of Florence blesses the first foundation stone for the new campanile (bell tower) of the Florence Cathedral, designed by the artist Giotto di Bondone.
1723 – Johann Sebastian Bach leads the first performance of his cantata Erforsche mich, Gott, und erfahre mein Herz, BWV 136, in Leipzig on the eighth Sunday after Trinity.

events.label: Образование
entries: 1555 – The College of Arms is reincorporated by Royal charter signed by Queen Mary I of England and King Philip II of Spain.
1968 – Intel is founded in Mountain View, California.

events.label: Литература
entries: 1806 – A gunpowder magazine explosion in Birgu, Malta, kills around 200 people.
